# Watch Dogs 2 Bluetooth Controller Fix v0.9.0-beta

First public beta of an experimental, build-specific offline single-player compatibility fix.

## What it fixes

The supported Watch Dogs 2 build can skip its native XInput backend when legacy DirectInput discovery does not report an Xbox controller connected over Bluetooth. The included proxy applies a minimal, guarded in-memory correction to that activation decision and forwards controller state and vibration unchanged to the genuine Windows XInput 9.1.0 DLL.

This is not virtual-controller emulation. It installs no driver and runs no background application.

## Tested

- Xbox Elite Wireless Controller Series 2 over Bluetooth and USB-C.
- Menus, gameplay, sticks, buttons, triggers, and vibration.
- Bluetooth-to-USB-C and USB-C-to-Bluetooth switching.
- Windows 10 x64, build 19045.

## Required game build

- `WatchDogs2.exe`: `DBC465877DD69F9B2C97B6004D713FC2C2166298514AF516AEE8BF2FBD0A97F3`
- `Disrupt_64.dll`: `1BC77B469A3591BEC36B3AF41D513F45BA2887BC338276B1388B5DD932CCD865`

Other Steam, Ubisoft Connect, Epic Games, regional, and updated builds have not been established as compatible. Verify hashes before installation.

## Installation

Download `WatchDogs2-BluetoothControllerFix-v0.9.0-beta.zip`, extract it, and copy `xinput9_1_0.dll` beside `WatchDogs2.exe` and `Disrupt_64.dll`. Read the included `README.txt` first, especially if another local `xinput9_1_0.dll` already exists.

## Safety

For legitimate offline single-player use only. Multiplayer and Easy Anti-Cheat-enabled use are unsupported. This project does not bypass or disable anti-cheat and does not modify original game files on disk.

## Checksums

- DLL: `F4112AFAB93E3A9200E2F442286A80EF76EA5BB0552CE9F0A68F2E004BED38CC`
- Release ZIP: `805DC6591B65483551CF4B4BFC13B48763F021054876AD560DDF42CC1CE8AF7D`

## Known limitations

- One exact engine/executable build is supported.
- Physical compatibility testing is currently limited to one controller model and environment.
- Other local XInput proxies and injected controller tools may conflict.
